title: Episode I
description: Bad circumstances have driven a few small-time outlaws to the town of Primrose Point. Now they must recuperate and investigate the town.

objectives.text: Enter Primrose Point to find shelter and check out the area.

title: Achieving Infamy
description: What's a group of outlaws without a reputation to precede them?

objectives.text: Find allies or uncover new ways to build your reputation and value.
